Swami Prabhupada and Making of ISKCON
Jagannath mandir aur rath yatra se jura episod yahan dekhie
# In the 1960s, A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada founded ISKCON (International Society for Krishna Consciousness) in New York.
# The organization’s growth was fueled by the American hippie movement. Prabhupada’s message of Krishna devotion and a simple lifestyle resonated with young people.
# A key turning point was a collaboration with The Beatles' George Harrison, whose music helped popularize the Hare Krishna mantra.
